purpose: Introduce Spring REST Docs to generate snippets from all 29 existing E2E tests (tests-as-docs philosophy per Major correction in .review.md). Establish convention for future endpoints.
rationale: Review (.review.md) records the Major correction (5 happy paths -> all 29 E2E tests) and its 7 cascading effects.
tdd-endpoint Skill does NOT cleanly apply (no new endpoints — adding documentation to existing). Custom phase structure below.

design_principles.scope: per-batch plan for REST Docs introduction. NOT a TDD task — adding document() to passing tests.
design_principles.ownership: AI-drafted from reviewed Task Context, frozen at execution time

phases.name: Infrastructure

operations.content_summary: Add plugins block entry: id("org.asciidoctor.jvm.convert") version "4.0.5". Add tasks.asciidoctor { inputs.dir(snippetsDir); dependsOn(tasks.test) }. Optional: bootJar copy to static/docs.

Add @AutoConfigureRestDocs class-level annotation. Add private static ResponseFieldsSnippet errorResponseFields() helper (returns responseFields with code/message/path/timestamp/errors[]/errors[].field/errors[].message; later ones .optional()).

phases.verification: ./gradlew test (existing 38 still green; no snippets yet because no document() calls)

operations.content_summary: Add andDo(document("post-create-{case}", ...)) to 7 POST tests. happy uses requestFields(PostCreateRequest fields) + responseFields(PostResponse) + responseHeaders(Location). 6 validation use requestFields + errorResponseFields().

Add document() to 7 GET-list tests. happy/multi/paginated use requestParameters(page/size) + responseFields(PageResponse + nested content[]). 4 validation use requestParameters + errorResponseFields().

Add document() to 4 GET-by-id tests. happy uses pathParameters(id) + responseFields(PostResponse). 404 uses pathParameters + errorResponseFields(). non-numeric uses pathParameters only (no body assertion).

Add document() to 7 PUT tests. happy uses pathParameters + requestFields(PostUpdateRequest) + responseFields(PostResponse). 404 uses pathParameters + requestFields + errorResponseFields(). 5 validation use pathParameters + requestFields + errorResponseFields().

Add document() to 4 DELETE tests. success uses pathParameters only (204 no body). 404/twice use pathParameters + errorResponseFields(). soft-excluded-from-list uses pathParameters only (asserts side-effect on subsequent GET, doc captures DELETE call).

AsciiDoc source with: title + intro + 5 endpoint sections (== headers). Each endpoint has === subsections per case, each subsection includes http-request, http-response, and relevant fields/parameters via include::{snippets}/<id>/<file>[].
Full chain: tests pass -> snippets generated -> asciidoctor renders -> build/docs/asciidoc/index.html exists and is readable.

Add new monitoring entry: 'REST Docs document() per E2E test pattern' (count=1). Note `errorResponseFields()` shared helper as additional pattern. Note 'tests-as-docs philosophy' as separate philosophical entry (may not be a Skill candidate).

global_verification: Each snippet directory has at least http-request.adoc + http-response.adoc.
build/docs/asciidoc/index.html generated and visually navigable in browser.
errorResponseFields() helper invoked from 16 error tests (POST 6 + PUT 6 + 4 not-found).

parallel_execution_strategy.Phase 1: 2 edits to different files -> single block, 2 invokes.
parallel_execution_strategy.Phase 2-6: Each phase is single-file (PostControllerE2ETest) sequential edits. Could be combined into one phase if edit blocks don't overlap, but separated for clarity and incremental verification.
parallel_execution_strategy.Phase 7: index.adoc write + tracker edit -> parallel block; verify + commit sequential.

commit_message_summary: Add REST Docs snippets for all 29 E2E tests + index.adoc + asciidoctor
process_note: Per Week 1 spec deliverable 'AI 이해 요약 + 수정 흔적 1개 이상 기록', this batch and the .review.md sister file together comprise the visible before/after record. .review.md §1=BEFORE, §2=AFTER, §4=Trace table with both columns.
